topic.title: Compare Changes and Resolve Conflicts
topic.shortdesc: Compare local changes with the latest committed version and review conflicted files in the compare editor.

body.p: To compare your current changes with the latest committed version, double-click a file in the Unstaged files area or Staged files area. The Compare Files window opens and highlights the changes.
If the file has a conflict, the 3-way file comparison tool shows the local change, the remote change, and the original base revision.
